textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 maths · Fractions · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: A fraction names equal parts of a whole. If a whole is cut into 3 equal parts, each part is one-third.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A fraction names equal parts of a whole. If a whole is cut into 3 equal parts, each part is one-third.
beats.speakEn: A fraction names equal parts of a whole. If a whole is cut into 3 equal parts, each part is one-third.

beats.en: When we compare two fractions of two different wholes, the two wholes must be the same size. One-third of a big chocolate can be bigger than one-half of a very small one.
beats.speakEn: When we compare two fractions of two different wholes, the two wholes must be the same size. One-third of a big chocolate can be bigger than one-half of a very small one.
